decisions.decision: Scope of work to exclude a garage; the committee seeks a like-kind estimate of a new building of the same uses.
decisions.quote: the scope of the work would not include a garage as the committee is looking for a like kind estimate of a new building

decisions.decision: Aim for the November town meeting, given the 60-day timeline and minimal scope.
decisions.quote: discussion took place on the 60 day timeline and the minimal scope of work and we would push for november town meeting.

decisions.decision: Greg Roy and the town manager to communicate with the architects in person, with renderings, materials sent 48 hours in advance, and the 60-day timeline.
decisions.quote: greg roy and the town manager would communicate with the architects 1) in person, 2) rendering outside, 3) materials provided 48 hours in advance, 4) 60 day timeline.

decisions.decision: Committee plans to meet in person; the town manager noted each committee decides and public access is required, so a hybrid is possible.
decisions.quote: greg roy stated we would plan to meet in person.
